install: if ((Get-FileHash "$env:TEMP/notepad-plus-plus.zip" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'cbcefa34677e10fe6dd19802f7d6b3b9860cd6de62afeaae7680e09c51b47779') { throw 'The Notepad++ ZIP does not match its pinned sha256.' }
apply: $on = if ($env:INGLENOOK_VARIANT -eq 'night') { 'yes' } else { 'no' }; Set-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/notepad++-$env:INGLENOOK_VERSION/config.xml" "<?xml version=`"1.0`" encoding=`"UTF-8`" ?>`n<NotepadPlus>`n    <GUIConfigs>`n        <GUIConfig name=`"DarkMode`" enable=`"$on`" colorTone=`"0`" enableWindowsMode=`"no`" darkThemeName=`"Inglenook Night.xml`" lightThemeName=`"Inglenook Day.xml`" />`n    </GUIConfigs>`n</NotepadPlus>`n"
stage: foreach ($v in 'Day', 'Night') { $f = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/notepad++-$env:INGLENOOK_VERSION/themes/Inglenook $v.xml"; (Get-Content $f -Raw).Replace('fontName="IBM Plex Mono" fontStyle="0" fontSize="10"', 'fontName="BlexMono Nerd Font Mono" fontStyle="0" fontSize="12"') | Set-Content $f -NoNewline }

$c = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/notepad++-$env:INGLENOOK_VERSION/config.xml"; (Get-Content $c -Raw).Replace('    </GUIConfigs>', "        <GUIConfig name=`"AppPosition`" x=`"360`" y=`"160`" width=`"1200`" height=`"760`" isMaximized=`"no`" />`n        <GUIConfig name=`"Caret`" width=`"1`" blinkRate=`"0`" />`n        <GUIConfig name=`"noUpdate`" intervalDays=`"15`" nextUpdateDate=`"20991231`" autoUpdateMode=`"1`">yes</GUIConfig>`n        <GUIConfig name=`"RememberLastSession`">yes</GUIConfig>`n    </GUIConfigs>") | Set-Content $c -NoNewline

$file = "$env:INGLENOOK_SCENE/content/Contrast.psm1"; $at = (Get-Content $file -Raw).IndexOf('$Hex.Substring') + 1; if ($at -lt 1) { throw 'The editor scene no longer has $Hex.Substring.' }; Set-Content "$env:LOCALAPPDATA/Programs/notepad++-$env:INGLENOOK_VERSION/session.xml" "<?xml version=`"1.0`" encoding=`"UTF-8`" ?>`n<NotepadPlus>`n    <Session activeView=`"0`">`n        <mainView activeIndex=`"0`">`n            <File firstVisibleLine=`"0`" startPos=`"$at`" endPos=`"$($at + 3)`" selMode=`"0`" filename=`"$((Resolve-Path $file).Path)`" />`n        </mainView>`n        <subView activeIndex=`"0`" />`n    </Session>`n</NotepadPlus>`n"
